# RBT Practice AI — Full Documentation for LLMs & AI Systems

> Complete reference of RBT Practice AI architecture, educational philosophy, BACB 3rd Edition domain breakdown, glossary terms, and API endpoints.

## 1. About RBT Practice AI
RBT Practice AI (https://rbtpracticeai.com) is an AI-powered educational technology platform engineered to train and prepare candidate Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) for the official certification exam administered by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board® (BACB®).

## 2. Core Educational Methodologies
- **Socratic Clinical Dialogue**: Interactive roleplays and distractor analysis helping candidates understand underlying behavioral principles.
- **Leitner Spaced Repetition**: Memory reinforcement scheduling based on cognitive recall strength (Boxes 1 through 5).
- **Domain Diagnostic Heatmaps**: Real-time statistical analysis identifying candidate weaknesses across Domains A through F.
- **Pass-or-Refund Guarantee**: 100% money-back guarantee for candidates scoring 85%+ on three full 85-question mock exams.

## 3. BACB 3rd Edition Domain Breakdown
### Domain A: Measurement (10 Questions)
- A-01: Prepare for data collection, continuous vs. discontinuous methods.
- A-02: Continuous measurement procedures (Frequency, Rate, Duration, Latency, IRT).
- A-03: Discontinuous measurement procedures (Partial Interval, Whole Interval, Momentary Time Sampling).
- A-04: Implement permanent-product recording procedures.
- A-05: Enter data and update client progress graphs.

### Domain B: Assessment (12 Questions)
- B-01: Collect ABC (Antecedent-Behavior-Consequence) narrative data.
- B-02: Conduct preference assessments (Free Operant, Single Stimulus, Paired Stimulus, MSW, MSWO).
- B-03: Assist with functional behavior assessment (FBA) procedures.

### Domain C: Skill Acquisition (24 Questions)
- C-01: Identify essential components of a written skill acquisition plan.
- C-02: Implement Discrete Trial Training (DTT) cycles.
- C-03: Implement Naturalistic Teaching / Incidental Teaching (NET).
- C-04: Implement Task Analyzed Chaining (Forward, Backward, Total Task).
- C-05: Implement Discrimination Training.
- C-06: Implement Stimulus Control Transfer procedures.
- C-07: Implement Prompt Fading and Prompt Hierarchy systems.
- C-08: Implement Shaping procedures.
- C-09: Implement Token Economy reinforcement schedules.

### Domain D: Behavior Reduction (12 Questions)
- D-01: Identify the 4 functions of behavior (SEAT: Sensory, Escape, Attention, Tangible).
- D-02: Understand and manipulate Motivating Operations (MO / EO / AO).
- D-03: Implement Differential Reinforcement (DRA, DRI, DRO, DRL).
- D-04: Implement Extinction procedures and manage Extinction Bursts.
- D-05: Follow Crisis / Emergency protocols.

### Domain E: Documentation and Reporting (10 Questions)
- E-01: Effectively communicate with supervisors in an objective, timely manner.
- E-02: Write objective session notes describing observable client behaviors.
- E-03: Comply with mandatory abuse and neglect reporting laws.

### Domain F: Professional Conduct and Scope of Practice (17 Questions)
- F-01: Maintain RBT Ethics Code 2.0 standards.
- F-02: Avoid dual relationships and conflicts of interest.
- F-03: Maintain client dignity and confidentiality (HIPAA / FERPA).
- F-04: Comply with BACB 5% monthly supervision requirements (minimum 2 face-to-face contacts).
